business_problem: TUI Musement needed to move beyond rigid SQL systems and slow planning processes so it could deliver hyper-personalized digital travel experiences with fast response times.
solution_summary: TUI Musement re-architected its travel operations on MongoDB Atlas to create a faster, more flexible data environment for customer-centric digital experiences. The team wanted a platform that could support interactive services, AI-first workflows, and operational excellence across a large tourism business, but traditional SQL systems made it hard to adapt schemas or move fast in the cloud. Atlas gave TUI a document-oriented operational platform that could be deployed quickly on AWS and extended beyond database storage into search and AI features. That foundation supports customer profiles, booking and transfer data, and the processes behind planning and recommendation experiences, all while reducing operational friction for developers. Because the platform is managed and scalable, TUI can focus on delivering hyper-personalized journeys, fast search, and automated workflows rather than maintaining database infrastructure. MongoDB thus became the backbone of a broader modernization program that TUI is rolling out across the business.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the managed operational data environment that powers TUI Musement's travel experiences, search, and AI-first workflows.

data_flow: Customer, booking, and operational travel data is managed in MongoDB Atlas, where the platform supports fast retrieval for planning and booking experiences and feeds the personalized workflows TUI Musement exposes to travelers and internal teams.
business_outcome: MongoDB Atlas helped TUI Musement cut planning experiences from 72 hours to a few minutes, deliver millisecond search performance, and scale travel services for tens of millions of customers.
